channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Creek Park Pavilion
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Creek Park Pavilion (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park Pavilion: The pavilion has floor-to-ceiling windows and patios…
item.description: The pavilion has floor-to-ceiling windows and patios overlooking Mission Creek. Mission Local reports it was "Empty from the early 2000s on" as a cafe (it was used for storage and for community and rental use) until Zocalo Coffee opened there on August 1, 2026 (reported September 5, 2026). Source: https://missionlocal.org/2026/09/san-francisco-zocalo-coffee-opening-mission-bay/; https://sfrecpark.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Mission-Creek-Park-North-and-South-449.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park Pavilion: The Mission Creek Park Pavilion record now cites Rec and…
item.description: The Mission Creek Park Pavilion record now cites Rec and Park's own 2025 request for proposals, which sought a 'café or recreational concession' (a use the Department solicited in February 2025, not a description of the building today), and Mission Local (September 2026), which reports that a café opened there on August 1, 2026. Source: SF Recreation and Parks, Mission Creek Pavilion RFP (sfrecpark.org/1823/Mission-Creek-Pavilion-RFP); Mission Local, 2026-09-05 (missionlocal.org/2026/09/san-francisco-zocalo-coffee-opening-mission-bay/).
item.source: SF Recreation and Parks, Mission Creek Pavilion RFP (sfrecpark.org/1823/Mission-Creek-Pavilion-RFP); Mission Local, 2026-09-05 (missionlocal.org/2026/09/san-francisco-zocalo-coffee-opening-mission-bay/)

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park Pavilion: The map notes gave 12 acres for Mission Creek Park and…
item.description: The map notes gave 12 acres for Mission Creek Park and called the pavilion adjacent to the Channel Street Dog Park; no cited source says either (Rec & Park says 'nearby'), so dated corrections were added and the summary no longer says adjacent. The NAIP aerial's credit now names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, as its catalog record does, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight. Source: SF Recreation and Park Department, Mission Creek Park Pavilion (https://sfrecpark.org/1704/Mission-Creek-Park-Pavilion); USDA NAIP imagery catalog record (https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip-imagery); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg); Mission Bay Parks, Mission Creek Park Pavilion (https://missionbayparks.com/venue/mission-creek-park-pavilion/) (does not state this); OpenStreetMap way 188854480 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/188854480) (does not state this).
